static-images.why: Repeated static content is the textbook CDN cue: edge caching cuts latency and origin load.

video-encoding.why: Long work belongs in background jobs. Encoding in the request 'works' but ties up connections and fails on timeouts.

too-much-data.why: Partitioning spreads storage and writes. Replicas help reads, not write volume or size limits.

read-heavy.why: A high read-to-write ratio suggests caching or replicas. Sharding could help eventually but is heavier than the problem needs. A cue suggests a component; requirements decide.

chat.why: Low-latency two-way messaging fits WebSockets; fan-out goes through pub/sub. Minute-level polling misses the latency target.

exactly-once-charges.why: Retries are inevitable; idempotency keys make a repeated request return the original result instead of charging again.
